why: Value formatting in output and error messages now uses pretty-format, changing displayed text.
String values in titles no longer have quotes, so generated test names change.
Default directory changed from .vitest-attachements/ to .vitest/attachments/.
Option removed in favor of concurrent; likely ignored or erroring, but it's unclear, so silent is the safer guess.
Locator is now an object rather than a string, so string use of it behaves differently.
The separate expect package is inlined, so imports of it may fail.
Deprecated entry points are removed, so importing them fails.
Older Node and Vite versions are no longer supported and will fail.
A poll that doesn't resolve in time now fails the test instead of passing.
Hoistable methods outside the top-level scope now throw an error.
Matching is now strict, so assertions that passed before may fail; toMatchTextContent is the lenient alternative.
Config files in ancestor directories are no longer found, so a different config is used.
Package is no longer published, so installing or importing it fails.
The happy-dom/jsdom window object can now be mutated, where before it could not.
Ids are now 1-based instead of 0-based, which changes the values returned.
New config option for toMatchScreenshot; older versions would ignore it.
The fake timers update adds Temporal mocking, which changes what fake timers affect.
The webdriverio package is removed, so using it fails.
Mocks are now cleared before each test by default.
Suppresses a spurious warning and fails gracefully when a worker fails to start.
Doesn't say whether the user-facing API or behavior changes.
Inline projects now extend the root config by default, which changes their resolved config.
Temporal can now be mocked without fake timers, changing existing behavior.
Nested projects are now supported, which older versions did not do.
The separator in the -t filter is now `>`, so existing patterns match differently.
Tests with un-awaited async assertions now fail instead of passing silently.
Inline projects now share one Vite server, changing how their config and plugins behave without errors.
vitest list now parses files statically by default instead of running them, which can change the output.
The public benchmark API was rewritten, so benchmark code written for the old API will fail.
Locators now match exactly by default, so existing browser locators may select different or fewer elements.
The include/exclude globs were too eager and now match differently, which changes which files are covered.
toThrow("") behavior is reverted, so the same assertion gives a different result.
An automock is now deserialized as an automock, which changes mock behavior when it passes between processes.
The blob, json and junit reporters and --merge-reports now read and write under .vitest by default, so existing paths in CI stop matching.
Class mocks now keep prototype methods on instances, which changes what instances of mocked classes do.
The new promise-aware expect and matcher types can produce type errors in existing code.
The html reporter's default output moved to .vitest, and the UI API access was hardened, so previous usage can stop working.
Adds the createReport API and a .vitest report directory convention.
Adds configDefaults.reporters, which older versions don't have.
Merge reports now work for non-sharded multi-environment runs.
Adds the logger.formatError method, which older versions lack.
Adds support for TypeScript build mode.
Adds the injectCjsGlobals option, which older versions would reject as an unknown option.
fsModuleCache is promoted to a top-level option, so the old experimental location is no longer the right name.
Non-ASCII characters in for/each title placeholders are now handled, which changes the generated test titles.
The duration breakdown is now reported as percentages, which changes the reporter output.
parseSpecifications is promoted out of experimental, so it has a new stable name.
clearCache is promoted out of experimental, so it has a new stable name.
The API now exposes logs recorded during the test, which older versions don't have.
Adds a pluggable benchmark provider API, which older versions don't have.
Adds new browser APIs (aria tree utils, context.mark, custom kind in page.mark) that older versions simply lack.
New --repeats CLI option and -p shorthand for --project, which older versions reject as unknown options.
V8 coverage now tracks child_process/worker_threads and the istanbul packages switch, changing coverage output for existing config.
New jest-junit-compatible naming options for the JUnit reporter; older versions would ignore them.
Adds single-file HTML reporter output and a custom GitHub Actions summary title option.
UI trace-view interaction tweaks that don't change any code, config, or callable API.
New vi.when() API that throws on older versions where it doesn't exist.
require(esm) now works in vm pools, where it previously failed.
The sequential test API and options are deprecated and still work, and global concurrent handling changes.
Test tags options now overwrite inherited suite options instead of merging, changing how existing tests resolve options.
Entry only says optimize deps config was updated without saying what changed.
Publish workflow shell injection fix in CI, not observable to vitest users.
attachmentsDir is now a root-only config, so per-project values are presumably ignored.
CJS interop is now applied for truthy __esModule, changing how existing imports resolve.
Fixes the callsite in async error stacks of vi.defineHelper to what it is meant to show.
Makes browser mode respect the documented disableConsoleIntercept option.
Fixes forceRerunTriggers directory globs so they match files as documented.
Unifies typechecking and AST collection internally with no described user-visible change.
Stops a typecheck warning from printing repeatedly.
Corrects a column number when parsing tests.
Fixes mixed stdout/stderr log timestamps in onUserConsoleLog.
Fixes importOriginal failing with the optimizer and query imports.
Corrects a transform time calculation in merged reports.
Fixes setImmediate awaiting in detect-async-leak.
Fixes per-project sequence config so it works as documented.
A handshake timeout for internal iframe communication is not something users call or configure.
Test names no longer include the column when includeTaskLocation is enabled, so output differs for existing config.
HMR is now disabled before plugins read it in their config hook, so plugin config hooks see different values.
Shutdown ordering of the pool and Vite servers is not observable by users.
Removing listeners in the typecheck worker's off is an internal cleanup.
Restores per-file isolation in vm pools with maxWorkers 1, which is what the docs say.
A CI workflow warning in the repository does not affect users.
Fixes a double node: prefix on builtins that was a bug.
A throwing teardown during close now yields a non-zero exit code, so runs that previously passed in CI now fail.
A Windows-specific race in the typechecker spawn grace period is an internal timing fix.
Coalesces concurrent watch-mode restarts to fix a race and deflake a test fixture.
Stops a false success when tsc crashes, so typecheck now reports the failure it should have.
In-source tests were missed when the module was cached, which was a bug.
Swapped arguments made the timeout error stack show the wrong message, and now it shows the real one.
Fixes automocking breaking from stale mock metadata with isolate:false.
Fixes lost worker output on teardown and flaky tests.
Restores a global concurrency limit for test lifecycle that was meant to work.
Fixes watch restart rerun ownership and keeps process.exit disabled in workers as intended.
Preserves the correct root during config resolution, which fixes a bug.
Multiple --project filters now combine correctly, as documented.
Fixes the recordArtifact location when used with vi.defineHelper.
Resolved setup files are now invalidated properly, which fixes stale behavior.
vi.when thenResolve now accepts the awaited value, which fixes a typing or behavior mismatch.
Static collection now ignores computed member calls, which fixes incorrect collection.
Stops duplicating oxc.target when the user supplies a custom array.
Makes --maxWorkers apply to projects as the option already implied.
Corrects the order in which queued doMock() calls are applied.
Only adds a diagnostic warning about duplicate plugins; no behavior change.
Fixes static collection to treat test.describe as a suite, as expected.
Built-in browser commands now check fs access and the cdp API is disabled when allowWrite/allowExec is false, so previously working calls can be rejected.
Resiliency fix for fsModuleCache.
Fixes FORCE_COLOR precedence and CTRL+c exit.
coverage.exclude no longer inherits negation globs from test.include, changing which files are covered.
Fake-timers update adds toNotFake support, which older versions would ignore.
Type allowance for readonly collections and a nullish toHaveProperty fix.
JUnit XML report output now includes unhandled errors.
Redirect mocks are now restricted to the fs allowlist, so redirects outside it fail.
Worker crash handling and memory-limit fixes.
Reporter robustness fixes.
Reporter output fixes.
Runner correctness fixes (describe.for flags, concurrency, leaks).
toMatchFileSnapshot now rejects sharing a snapshot file with toMatchSnapshot, and snapshot assertions fail under test.fails.
Spy typing and error message improvement.
Better error reporting for a typecheck crash on Windows.
Types fix so documented changed option is accepted.
Mostly UI fixes; auth hardening is a security fix to the UI server.
Avoids a crash on malformed inline source map.
The './src/*' export was removed from package.json, so such imports now fail to resolve.
VM pool fixes for resolution errors, memory retention, and cache fallback.
Headless Chrome under webdriverio now allows the GPU, changing launch behavior.
Binds stdio early so overridden stdio no longer breaks the worker, which is a bug fix.
Performance optimization of diff stringification with no observable change.
Hot-path performance improvement with no user-visible change.
Performance work on module serving; the compile cache was made opt-in in the next entry.
Says the Node compile cache is opt-in but does not name the option or how to enable it.
Reuses compiled code and prewarms the module graph as a performance optimization.
Bundling vitest's own dependencies is a packaging change with no API effect.
Lower peak memory with --changed; behavior is the same.
Internal initialization optimization for the trace view.
Browser-mode performance optimizations with no change to what users call or get.
Cache key hashing optimization.
Coverage report speedups and fewer serializations, with the same output.
Matcher state and failure formatting performance tweaks.
Spy performance optimization with the same behavior.
Environments can now opt out of the VM module graph prewarm; older versions ignore the extra setting.
